comment: A fresh profile opens with the Reference docker closed, so Ctrl+Alt+S runs nothing and the corner says what the chord does and that Shift+F shows the docker. Shift+F opens it on an empty board, where the same chord says there is no picture to show alone. A picture opened and selected, the chord solos it, and the dump's reference block reads solo 0 with the corner quiet, the line before it having faded. Tab then hides every docker, and the chord says the hidden line again with the solo left as it was. The state beside each shot carries the notice's text and whether it is showing.
